notes.title: The Online Obsession Demo is Now Out!
notes.content:
The Online Obsession Demo is now out!

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/575a13872584601801417256e42d8ed3/b66c2b4df94f549d-d4/s540x810/1c5efd103956349b80d63b07f2bdbe4d9379b0aa.pnj[/img]

Have you ever had an online friend? What if you were to meet them in real life? Can you be sure that nothing will go wrong? 

Find out in this horribly adorable experience!

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/b22e8a1b3bcdd98aa853ffc9f41ff163/b66c2b4df94f549d-b3/s540x810/227b556ab900d4c7d826496c469cf7b5331fdaf9.pnj[/img]
[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/5544acf40de14afc69beaed78613e128/b66c2b4df94f549d-01/s540x810/f4573a3f4696e50bca6602a7b940bc4895490ea2.pnj[/img]
[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/ce63f8a108ffd6712def1f5a197ec5ee/b66c2b4df94f549d-98/s540x810/21cf5dbbb2755de49a474774c2ad62812d930cea.pnj[/img]
Don't let this cute cover deceive you - this is a horror experience, so please carefully read the "mature content" section for a full list of trigger warnings. Though the demo does not have a lot of scary content, the full game does.

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/930e3737f106ceb427d73e8c1f77062b/b66c2b4df94f549d-3a/s540x810/3b877bc1901b0344c648b20ebdb6ecf746b2bd77.pnj[/img]
[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/5b8e641894cd42764d5173349cb23730/b66c2b4df94f549d-3d/s540x810/0a25aa780a3aca23439124a253cba29970326f35.pnj[/img]

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/28bf311eb532a9bce72fe9dd647021c6/b66c2b4df94f549d-2a/s540x810/f860d3bc6babea9d99451d30de7d14c97807dac9.pnj[/img]

You play as a university student who is obsessed with this new online shooter game called Star Blitz. Will you finally meet your best friend Adisorn you’ve first met in this game? Ah, right, about Adisorn!

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/15aa8ca6d547e9e6f7fe21cb69c842cd/b66c2b4df94f549d-62/s540x810/f7995d24b3b8a512ba70274facc3f25d252b5ddb.pnj[/img]

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/99ad4a330f60b58f725def39c75d2dfb/b66c2b4df94f549d-2e/s540x810/2b3c2edc4028f799f9176a8366451f8ebeba23d4.pnj[/img]
The demo features:

[list]
[*] Character customisation that includes pronouns, personality, skin colour, hair texture, length and colour
[*] Choice, exploration and mini-game based gameplay
[*] Linear preview with lots of choices
[/list]

Download now on the main[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2614590/Online_Obsession/] Steam[/url] store page! Enjoy and Happy Valentine's, everyone 💕
